_comment: Example read-model config for the HOSTED cockpit (Phase 16). Copy to read-models.hosted.json (gitignored) OR provide the same values via Worker env/secrets. Use ONLY read-only anon keys — NEVER a service-role key. The browser never receives any key; the Worker calls Supabase RPCs server-side.

_safety.note: If a hosted read-model would require a service-role key, stop and report — do not ship. Read-only anon keys only.
